data.title: Junior Frontend Developer
data.fitReason: Bootcamp training typically covers frontend fundamentals. To-do list app demonstrates practical understanding of UI/UX, DOM manipulation, and basic state management. Ready for structured junior roles with mentorship.

data.title: Junior Full-Stack Developer
data.fitReason: Bootcamps often teach both frontend and backend basics. To-do list app likely includes some backend component. Candidate is positioned to grow into full-stack role with guidance and more projects.

data.title: Junior JavaScript Developer
data.fitReason: Bootcamp graduates typically specialize in JavaScript. To-do list app demonstrates working knowledge of JS fundamentals, DOM, and event handling. Specialized junior role aligns with bootcamp curriculum focus.

data.title: QA Automation Tester
data.fitReason: Some bootcamps include testing frameworks and automation. Technical foundation from bootcamp and practical coding experience translates to QA automation entry-level roles. Lower barrier than pure development roles.

data.title: Web Developer
data.fitReason: Generic web developer title for entry-level positions. Bootcamp training and working to-do list app demonstrate core competencies. Common entry point for bootcamp graduates seeking remote work.

data.title: Junior React Developer
data.fitReason: Many modern bootcamps include React. To-do list app may have been built with React. Component-based architecture is foundational for junior React roles. Specialized enough for bootcamp graduate focus.

data.title: Technical Support Engineer
data.fitReason: Bootcamp technical foundation and ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical users. Lower coding intensity role that leverages technical skills without requiring production experience.

data.title: Associate Software Engineer
data.fitReason: Standard entry-level title for bootcamp graduates. Implies structured onboarding and mentorship. Bootcamp completion and working project demonstrate readiness for associate-level coding responsibilities.

data.title: Junior Node.js Developer
data.fitReason: Node.js is commonly taught in full-stack bootcamps. Server-side JavaScript specialization leverages bootcamp training. To-do list app likely has Node backend. Growing demand for Node specialists.

data.title: Junior HTML/CSS Developer
data.fitReason: Foundational web technologies taught in all bootcamps. To-do list app includes HTML/CSS work. More limited scope than full developer roles but realistic entry point for remote opportunities.
